name: Esper Gyou ★ Shoshi Ritsuko
original_name: エスパー行★書士リツコ
source:
Toujou Ritsuko is a lawyer who has a supernatural power. She helps others with her ability and experience.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE143335.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
东条リツコ是一名拥有超能力的行政书士。她运用自身的能力与经验，帮助有困难的人。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE143335.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
